name: ARGO-YBJ Collaboration
notes: The official collaboration page lists a spokesperson for each side (B. D'Ettorre Piazzoli for the Italian side and C. Zhen for the Chinese side, lists dated 2009 and 2005); no leadership rows are written because no person records exist.

summary.plain: An Italian-Chinese collaboration of institutes of the INFN and the Chinese Academy of Sciences that built and ran ARGO-YBJ.
summary.technical: Italian institutes (Lecce, Napoli, Roma Tor Vergata, Roma Tre, Torino, Catania/Palermo, Pavia) and Chinese institutes (IHEP Beijing, Shandong, Southwest Jiaotong, Tibet University, Yunnan, Zhengzhou, Hong Kong); two spokespersons (list dated 2009).
